setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 through a MIDI device: four trigs on steps 1 to 4 with the notes C, D, E and F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97. The sequencer is stopped and three MIDI ports are connected. The norns shows channel 1's Device screen.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: On Channel, hold step 1 at (1,4) and tap step 24 to set the channel range to steps 1 to 24. Open Pattern (5,8) and tap steps 2, 3 and 4 to clear those trigs, then hold step 1 and tap step 24 to give the one remaining trig a length of 24 steps: four seconds. Press Song (6,8), then Play (1,8). C (MIDI 60) starts and keeps sounding; the MIDI strip "MIDI sent in this step" shows only its Note On.
steps.title: Start one long note

steps.caption: While C sounds, hold Channel (3,8), a page you are not on. Keep holding until Panic cuts the note, then release the key. Allow about two seconds for the hold. Here the note is cut off 1.26 seconds after it starts, before its natural four-second end. That interval starts at note onset, not at the start of the hold. Song playback continues, so C sounds again when the loop comes round. Press Stop at (1,8) to stop the sequence.
steps.title: Hold Channel to panic

title: Panic silences a note that is still sounding
